podcast.body: Sloan's ninth studio record, released in 2008, notable for being their shortest at just over 37 minutes and featuring 13 songs. The title refers to a child psychology term where children play beside each other without interacting, humorously reflecting the band's collaborative yet often individualistic songwriting and recording process, particularly evident on this album which was made quickly in their rehearsal studio. "Sloan with Believe in Me, the first single from their 2008 album, Parallel Play."
